ulasan.Ulasan: One month ago we bought a retired female Yorkshire Terrier from Zainy. She promised us that she would provide us with paperwork providing her birth info and proof of vaccines. She keeps promising me that she will send but hasn’t. Everything this woman told us about the dog was a lie. She told us she was 5-6 lbs, a year old and had never had a litter as they were getting out of the business. When we went to meet her it was clear she was emaciated and abused. You could feel her spine and hip bones. Nails were very long. She had always been kept in a kennel. We decided to take her and not leave her there. After taking her to our vet it was determined she was more 2-3 years old and definitely had litters. Her teeth were in bad shape. The amount of lies we were told then and this past month are too much to type here. I would advise you to not buy a dog from these people. This is clearly a puppy mill situation. The day we picked up the dog she was 6.6 lbs. One month later she is now 8 lbs., less fearful and doing very well. Do not believe anything Zainy tells you. Everything she tells you is a lie. I have everything documented.
